author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,
I just want to release a CTW Map I created long time ago, but I just made the YAML now xD 

Tyrsus 


Title: Tyrsus
Created By: resepignev
Game: CTW (Nebula)
Teams: Purple vs. Red
Details: A CTW map filled up with features for new kinds of playing. The beacon beams are marking the one way teleporters. You only can be teleported to the back of the map. There are also saverooms for the rushers. You are save in the rooms and if you leave you'll get a resistance boost, so nobody can kill you if you leave the save room. And the last major feature is the villager trading system. You can trade some of your spawnkit for new items like speed potions for rushing on the map and faster getting the wool back. 
Download: [Here]
Pictures: [Here]
YAML: [Here]
Screenshots: 


The YAML with over 500 lines took around 5 hours to make. (Report bugs with the map please [Here]. Thank you <3)
